item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on technocrats, security appointments, institutional reform, and nuclear/security decision-making. I did not find a direct source showing Abiy created an expert-led nuclear-security council, independent advisory structure, or formal safeguards body. I also did not find a direct source proving the opposite in a nuclear-specific sense. So the best-supported reading is indirect: some real institution-building in disaster response and peaceful nuclear cooperation, but stronger evidence of centralized and politicized security governance.","evidence":[{"title":"Commission Revamping Disaster Response Works to Address Humanitarian Needs","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-04-26","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4358046","summary":"Ethiopia’s Disaster Risk Management Commission said it was overhauling structure, policy, staffing, and technology to improve emergency management and response capacity.
